Package edu.towson.cosc442.halls7800.entity

Class Creature

java.lang.Object
edu.towson.cosc442.halls7800.engine.Actor
edu.towson.cosc442.halls7800.entity.Creature
Direct Known Subclasses:
Companion, Monster, Npc, Player
public abstract class Creature extends Actor
A living thing that occupies a tile on a floor: the player, monsters and NPCs.

Creatures have hit points, combat ratings (accuracy, evasion, armor), a base action cost that sets their speed, and a set of status effects. Subclasses supply their attacks.
